generate_synthetic_arithmetic_dataset: generate a synthetic arithmetic dataset sample using encode_pure_arithmetic with a seeded random number generator
encode_arithmetic_expression: encode a pure arithmetic expression into tokenized text with modular arithmetic operations
configure_arithmetic_operations: configure the arithmetic operations by setting ttype to asm for addition subtraction and multiplication
set_modulus_value: set the value_mod parameter to control the modular arithmetic range for generated expressions
toggle_knowledge_augmentation: toggle knowledge_augment to enable or disable dual operator ID encoding in arithmetic samples
